header.label: OpenAEC Ecosystem
header.title: Open Calc Studio
header.desc: Open source cost estimation tool for construction budgets and cost calculations.

why.title: Why Open Calc Studio?
why.desc: Cost estimates and budgets are essential for every construction project, but existing tools are expensive and proprietary. Open Calc Studio offers a fully open source alternative with direct connections to STABU/RAW and the IFCX ecosystem.

stabu.title: STABU/RAW integration
stabu.desc: Full support for STABU and RAW standards for standardized specifications and cost estimates.

ifcx.title: IFCX quantity linking
ifcx.desc: Automatically extract quantities from IFCX models for accurate calculations directly from the BIM model.

export.title: Quote export
export.desc: Generate professional quotes and export to PDF, Excel or other common formats.

multiproject.title: Multi-project management
multiproject.desc: Manage multiple projects simultaneously with clear dashboards and project comparisons.

library.title: Cost library
library.desc: Build and maintain a reusable library with unit prices, materials and labor standards.

reports.title: Report generation
reports.desc: Create detailed reports with cost overviews, comparisons and trend analyses.
